title: Dream Come True Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Dream Come True is a 3 BR / 3 BA / 8 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Dream Come True is a recently renovated cottage on West Ruskin street just 3 houses from 30A.
description_expanded: Description31 WEST RUSKIN STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 2 DOUBLES, 1 DAYBED W/TRUNDLE (Sleeps 8) Prime Location Near the Beach & Town CenterWelcome to Dream Come True, a beloved Seaside family home perfectly positioned just 240 feet from beach access and only a 3-minute walk to downtown Seaside and the Amphitheater. With over 35 shops and restaurants just steps away, this home offers the rare convenience of leaving the car parked and enjoying Seaside entirely on foot. Upon arrival, guests can park in the private parking area and settle into the charming front porch, complete with a bistro dining set for two and a porch swing, overlooking the lush, fenced yard.Open-Concept Living with Indoor–Outdoor FlowStep inside to a bright, open floor plan designed for connection and comfort. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a five-burner electric stove, a large double-door refrigerator, and ample cookware for easy family meals. A breakfast bar with seating for four flows seamlessly into the dining area, where a farmhouse-style table seats six for shared meals and game nights. Just beyond the living space, an open-air deck offers Adirondack seating and a peaceful view of the private yard—perfect for relaxing while little ones play nearby.Comfortable Living Spaces & Main-Level Primary SuiteThe living room is welcoming and spacious, furnished with a large sectional, two club chairs, and a large flat-screen TV, making it ideal for unwinding after a day at the beach. An updated full bathroom with a single vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower is conveniently located on the main level. Also on this floor is the king primary bedroom, featuring generous closet space, a mounted flat-screen TV, and a beautifully marble-renovated ensuite bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Guest Bedrooms & Balcony Views UpstairsUpstairs, guests will find two additional bedrooms designed for comfort and flexibility. The second bedroom includes two double beds, a closet, and a private TV, while the third bedroom features a queen bed and access to an open-air balcony with lovely palm tree views. A second updated full bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination serves this level.Bonus Loft, Rooftop Deck & Tower RetreatOne of the home’s most memorable features is the bonus loft and rooftop deck, accessed by stairs from the living room. The loft includes a cozy seating nook and a twin trundle, sleeping two additional guests. From here, step out onto a spacious open-air deck with bar seating for four, ideal for sunset cocktails. A final set of stairs leads to the covered tower area, where Adirondack bar seating for three and elevated views of Seaside Street create a magical spot to relax and listen to the nearby waves.Thoughtful Extras for a Seamless StayAdditional amenities include a charcoal grill, an outdoor shower, and a laundry closet with a full-size stackable washer and dryer. With its exceptional location, layered outdoor spaces, and family-friendly layout, Dream Come True lives up to its name—offering a classic Seaside vacation experience filled with comfort, charm, and unforgettable moments.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Please note: There is nearby construction that may impact your stay. For more information, feel free to contact us directly.FEATURES1,706 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space240 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private residential beach on 30AJust four houses from the beach and one block from the Seaside AmphitheaterPrivate drivewayPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued; a golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002375
